purpose: Deterministic isolated-pulse SSFM trajectories for the Blender Kerr films; distinct from the 1600 km DP-16QAM study.

pulse.polarizations: Equal coherent XY envelopes, Ax=Ay=sqrt(Ppeak/2)*exp(-t^2/(2*T0^2)); powers and spectra are added incoherently across orthogonal XY.

display.field_convention: E=Re[A(t)*exp(i*(k*z-omega0*t))]; delta_omega=-d(arg(A))/dt; physical spectral offset=-numpy FFT frequency.
display.spectrum_units: J/Hz: |dt*FFT(A_pol)|^2. Integral over physical frequency is pulse energy per polarization.
display.loss_policy: Raw power and spectral energy retain physical attenuation. A film may divide by attenuation_power_factor to isolate shape, only with an explicit loss-compensated label and fixed input normalization.

scope.model: Lossy second-order-dispersion DP Manakov equation with instantaneous Kerr and factor 8/9; existing propagate_fiber only.
scope.amplifiers: None. No EDFA gain or ASE is applied; their LinkConfig fields are inactive for propagate_fiber.
scope.transmitter: Single deterministic Gaussian envelope. No 16QAM symbols, RRC filtering, receiver DSP or bit-error measurement.
scope.sample_rate: symbol_rate_hz*sps only defines Fs=4.096 THz here; the pulse is not a 32 GBd data stream.
